title: Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Clarifier sludge scraper blade requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by clarifier sludge scraper blade and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for wastewater geometry
TIG welding all-position with Class 6g gauge
Passivation DI rinse with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for clarifier sludge scraper application
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion under gasket in wet service - mitigated by raised-face flange design per ASME B16.5 — critical for clarifier sludge scraper performance

faq.q: What pH range can Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade withstand in effluent streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains corrosion rates below 0.05 mm/year across pH 2-12 at 40°C in chloride-containing effluents. For clarifier sludge scraper handling acidic or alkaline waste streams, titanium eliminates the need for polymer linings or acid-resistant brick, reducing maintenance costs by approximately 60% over the 10-year design life.

Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for clarifier sludge scraper.
